## Checklist

- [ ] Folder name matches `name` in the frontmatter
- [ ] `metadata.journalit-tools` lists every Journalit tool the skill uses
- [ ] `metadata.writes` is correct, and if `"true"` the skill previews before committing
- [ ] Step 1 tells the agent to read the core `journalit` skill
- [ ] Markdown and images only, no scripts or download links
- [ ] No real journal data, account numbers or P&L screenshots
- [ ] No financial advice, profit promises or mental health diagnosis
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_skills.py` passes
